R308_evidence_summary: R308 found the model was tautological: the wash-out gate was defined to equal the drug-release trigger. Real pharmacokinetic model needed. Article XXIX §1: mechanism failure (model structure invalid), not parameter bug.
R309_role: REPAIR CANDIDATE — one repair attempt per Article XXXVI §4. Replace tautological model with real PK model (COPASI). If real-PK model fails pre-registered criterion, P-05 → cemetery. No V3.
R309_action_plan: Step 1: Replace tautological model with real PK model using COPASI (Standard Simulator Registry). Use published CSF pharmacokinetic parameters (e.g., published gentamicin CSF PK data).
Step 2: Re-preregister falsification criterion: drug concentration at target tissue must exceed therapeutic threshold for ≥ X hours per week.
Step 3: Re-run model against new criterion.
Step 4: If PASS: proceed through completion pipeline. If FAIL: P-05 → cemetery (Article XXXVI §4: second failure is terminal).
R309_target_state: EITHER TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY (if repair succeeds) OR CEMETERY (if repair fails)
machine_blockers: Repair budget = 1 (Article XXXVI §4). Real PK model must produce therapeutic drug levels.
special_note: R308 provenance chain (already documented, exemplar for Article XXXVI §10): tautology → mechanism invalid → real PK → fail → no value (if real-PK repair fails).
